about: What Register-AgentRegistry.ps1 lists in the Google Cloud Agent Registry (project rabbitsoftware-io). Only things that run in Google Cloud and answer a protocol are registered; the full list of agents, including the ones that run on the owner's PC or on Cloudflare, is docs/agents.md.

entries.description: Searches public biomedical research live (PubMed, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov, openFDA) and returns short lists with links. It also looks up the public RabbitOS commands and the files behind them (the toolbox). Read only: stores nothing, holds no secrets, never sees personal data. Runs on Cloud Run as an A2A server.

Read-only tool server for AI assistants: platform links and status, the public chain and data hub, live public research search, the command catalog and help, anchoring and Hugging Face status. Public tools need no key.
